title: Scaffold: Electron + TypeScript app that builds, lints, typechecks and tests on Windows and Mac CI
summary: Creates the Electron + TypeScript app: electron-vite build, typed IPC bridge, feature auto-discovery, settings helper, packaging config, runbook skeleton, and the full gate in CI on Windows and Mac. 39 tests, 0 skipped; review added a settings lookup fix and a navigation guard so outside pages never get the IPC bridge.
lessons_learned: node-pty 1.1.0 ships its Mac spawn-helper without execute permission; the scaffold's postinstall script fixes it, and forcing a source rebuild of node-pty on Windows needs the MSVC Spectre-mitigated libraries (opt-in via npm run rebuild:native)

deferred.what: npm run dist on Windows fails without the Visual Studio MSVC Spectre-mitigated libraries, because npmRebuild: true rebuilds node-pty from source; GitHub's Windows runners were not checked for that component
deferred.why: The issue pins npmRebuild: true and installers are not built in the gate

deferred.what: Node is pinned to 24.4.1, a release from before the Node 24 line became LTS, so CI and every worktree build on a Node missing over a year of security fixes, and the exact engines value warns on any other 24.x
deferred.why: Only 24.4.1 is installed on the build machine, so a bump could not be verified there

deferred.what: An error thrown by any feature's register() at start-up is swallowed: no window opens and the process keeps running invisibly, which in the installed app leaves a background process the user can only end in Task Manager
deferred.why: No feature exists yet, and how to show a start-up error is a product choice
